messages:
Sarah (Partnerships): Quick sync re: AuroraCloud + EdgeMatrix joint workshop at DataInfra Summit next Tue. Need speaker lineup, demo failovers, and swag kit plan.
James (Events): Thanks — running through agenda. 30m panel + 45m hands-on. Who's confirmed speakers?
Sarah (Partnerships): Aurora: Priya (solutions), Marco (HW lead). EdgeMatrix: Kaito (integrations) tentative. Redwood: Alex (runtime) confirmed, Mei (devex) possibly for kit walkthrough.
Mei (Operations): I can do kit walkthrough if shipping clears. ETA for swag samples?
Luis (Supply): Swag samples ship Fri via courier. Tracking placeholder: UPS 1Z999XXXXX. Will post actual label when created.
Olivia (Marketing): Marketing needs headshots + 2-line bios by EOD Thu. Also need speaker slide template (2:1).
Alex (Eng): Demo fallback plan: primary on Dedicated pool; fallback: hosted model variant + pre-recorded demo video. I'll prep a <10s warmup script to prime caches.
Alex (Eng): Warmup snippet for runbook:
```
# warmup request
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"warmup","max_tokens":8}'
```
Mei (Operations): Kit contents proposal: USB-C power bank, 2 stickers, quickstart cheat-sheet, QR feedback card. Limit: 200 carry-on kits.
Luis (Supply): Budget note: power bank $9, stickers $0.40, printing $1.20 -> est total $11,000. Need PO request by Thu morning.
James (Events): Run-through Friday 11:00am PT. Can everyone make it?
Sarah (Partnerships): I can be on the call, :thumbsup:. Flight lands morning but I’ll be there.
Alex (Eng): For demo images: I'll push build to S3 path s3://redwood-events/aurora-edge-174. Label: event-aurora-174.
Mei (Operations): Can you include a small marshalling script so volunteers can flash USBs quickly?
Alex (Eng): Uploaded build and small checksum: abc123def. Location+notes in the runbook.
Mei (Operations): Packing command I'll run: `./pack-kits.sh --manifest manifest.csv --label event-aurora-174` — will attach manifest when ready.
James (Events): On-site logistics: swag pick-up at venue load-in 8:30am. Volunteers: Sarah, James, Kaito (if available), Priya?
Kaito (EdgeMatrix): I can pick up if timing works from my side — arrival ETA 8:00am local.
Olivia (Marketing): Post-event ask: include 2-min feedback QR on the kit + single-question NPS. I'll add sticker art.
calendar-bot: Invite created -> 'Aurora/EdgeMatrix Workshop - Runthrough' Fri 11:00am PT. RSVP updated.
Luis (Supply): Shipping label created placeholder UPS 1Z999XXXXX. Will update with real tracking after PO. Please ack when bios/headshots uploaded.
Sarah (Partnerships): Ack. I'll ping speakers for bios now.
James (Events): Thanks team — last-minute checklist for Fri run: 1) Confirm PO + labels, 2) Confirm bios/slide template, 3) Runbook link + warmup test, 4) Volunteer pickup roster.
Mei (Operations): I'll own labels + packing. Will post manifest by Thu 6pm PT.
Alex (Eng): I'll run a final end-to-end demo test Thu night and post results here.
Olivia (Marketing): I'll assemble speaker one-pager and add QR asset.
Luis (Supply): Final note: if we cut qty under 200, update manifest by Thu AM.
Sarah (Partnerships): Great — see you Fri run-through. :party_parrot:
